name: (Risen Nemesis) Fixated Obsession
text:
Frequency once per day

---
Effect The Risen Nemesis expresses a vengeful interest in a target within 30 feet. The creature must succeed at a DC 42 Will save save or become Sickened 1 for 1 minute (Sickened 2 on a critical failure). On failure or critical failure, the Risen Nemesis also gains a +2 status bonus on Strikes and damage rolls against the target until the target or the Risen Nemesis dies, whichever comes first.
